capabilities: Reveal an embedded file in the system file explorer
Reveal an embedded file in Obsidian's File Explorer sidebar
Copy the embedded file object to the OS clipboard
Copy the embedded file's absolute path or its parent folder path
disambiguation: Not a tool for creating or managing embeds; it only adds a right-click menu to files that are already embedded.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Copying binary file objects on Linux requires wl-copy (Wayland) or xclip (X11); some actions are desktop-only.
intentEvidence: Native right-click file operations for embedded attachments in Obsidian.
motivation: The author built it because interacting with the underlying file of an embed required locating it manually in the File Explorer sidebar first.
problem: Interacting with the actual file behind an embed usually requires hunting it down in the sidebar first, since embedded attachments offer no file operations in place.
summary: Context menu plugin that adds reveal, locate, and copy file operations to embedded attachments in reading view.
